contract_history.note: Contract/definition versions are fixed-snapshot technical bindings. Their registration/availability is not a market public time and does not establish business historical eligibility.

budget.note: The selected snapshot's files are verified once by read_snapshot; the selected product payload is read and verified once by read_product; declared read-dependency snapshots are dereferenced and verified once. Commit/snapshot/manifest metadata repeat reads are counted (selected 3x, each dependency 2x). No unrelated newer snapshot is scanned.

limitations: P4a1 只实现 read_product；read_company_context/read_relation_graph/read_applicable_rules/read_event_timeline/trace_evidence 尚未实现。
system_held_at 尚无目标实例持有台账，返回 INSTANCE_HOLDING_SCOPE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED；不把来源 _wfd_received_time 冒充目标实例持有。
没有文件范围/行组时间索引；max_scan_bytes 与 max_nodes 保守按该产品全部 manifest 文件预检，不声明下推。
底层存储 SDK 没有可中断的硬执行时间预算；不支持 max_execution_time_ms，不把读完后检查冒充限时。
这是 P4a1 有界实现，不声明完整 P4、实例持有、P5、P6 或 P7 已完成。
